C1.worst_defect: The home page never says who builds or maintains VendurePOS, or where to get support or report a bug; the footer offers only 'MIT licensed. Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.', and the demo's analytics go to an unexplained third-party domain, ph.wcpos.com. A buyer weighing it against Shopify POS or Square cannot tell who stands behind it.
C1.where: home/desktop/02 footer and 'Live demo or your own store' table; text/home.txt

C2.worst_defect: The hero, og card and JSON-LD ('isAccessibleForFree': true) present it as an open-source, free till. Only a later bullet says self-hosting needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token', and nowhere does it say that this is a paid proprietary licence or what it costs. The free route therefore depends on app.vendurepos.com, whose operator is never named. The latest plugin release is 2026-10-06 (0.2.0 and 0.3.0 share that date), six weeks before capture, while the demo already does refunds and customer notes the released plugin cannot.
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Before you start' bullet 5; limitations/desktop/01; changelog/desktop/01; tech.json home JSON-LD

C3.worst_defect: The role the plugin creates for tills is missing a permission it needs: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder to that role yourself'. Without it 'the till sells but its order history is refused'. The workaround is repeated on three pages instead of being fixed in a release.
C3.where: quick-start 'Optional: a device key for each till' (desktop/04); connect-a-till 'Give each cashier their own account' and 'Create and use a device key'

C4.worst_defect: The changelog is written for the plugin's own developers. Entries cite 'ADR 0005', 'ADR 0004', '#116' and '#117' with no links, and use protocol jargon such as 'order.create v5', 'maxShippingLines: 1' and 'lineTax: { none: true, classes: true }', so a store owner cannot tell what changed for them beyond the 'In short' line.

C5.worst_defect: In the hero screenshot the cart pane opens with a lone 'Park' label in a grey full-width bar that reads like a header, and the product grid is cut off part-way through a row of tiles at the frame's bottom edge.

C6.worst_defect: In the phone hero screenshot the cart's quantity column header is truncated to 'Q...', and the image (it starts at the bottom of home.phone.01) runs on into slice 02, so on a phone the product looks cramped before the reader reaches any feature copy.

C7.worst_defect: Every sitemap <lastmod> is the capture day or the evening before (2026-11-17T23:31 to 2026-11-18T11:05), even for the changelog, whose newest entry is 2026-10-06. The dates come from builds, not from content changes, so crawlers learn nothing from them. Docs pages carry only BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

overall_worst.defect: The site sells 'an open-source till' (hero, og card, JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree) but buries the fact that running it on your own host requires a paid, proprietary RxDB Premium licence. The cost is never stated, and the only free alternative is the hosted app.vendurepos.com, run by an operator the site never names, with no support or maintainer contact. A sceptic advising a client reads that as hidden lock-in on a pre-release project whose plugin has not shipped since 2026-10-06.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 'Before you start'; limitations/desktop/01; connect-a-till/desktop/01 'Where your data goes'
overall_worst.fix: In 'Before you start' and Limitations, state plainly that RxDB Premium is a paid commercial licence, with a link to its pricing. Add one line naming who runs app.vendurepos.com and maintains the project, with a support or issues link.
